title: Oishinbo Gourmet Manga Gets New TV Anime
content: The ABEMA Anime Matsuri 2026 event on Saturday revealed that storywriter Tetsu Kariya and artist Akira Hanasaki 's Oishinbo manga is getting a new television anime series titled Shin Oishinbo (New Oishinbo). Shinei Animation announced the anime at its 50th anniversary celebration stage presentation at the event.
author: ANN

title: Inherit the Winds Anime Reveals Theatrical Screening Trailer, Theme Songs, Additional Cast
content: The staff for the original television anime project Inherit the Winds ( Kaze wo Tsugumono ) began streaming on Saturday a trailer for the anime's advanced two-week screening. The staff also unveiled the theme songs and an additional cast member.
author: ANN

title: 'Dengeki Daisy' Unveils Additional Cast, Staff, First Promo, 2 Consecutive Cours for Winter 2027
content: The stage event for the television anime adaptation of Kyousuke Motomi 's Dengeki Daisy manga at the Kyoto International Manga Anime Fair 2026 revealed additional cast, staff, a key visual (pictured), and the first promotional video on Saturday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Yaiba: Samurai Legend Anime's 2nd Season Debuts on January 9
content: The official website for Yaiba: Samurai Legend ( Shin Samurai-den YAIBA ), the new television anime of Detective Conan creator Gōshō Aoyama 's Yaiba manga, revealed a new visual and January 2027 debut on Saturday for the anime's second season .
author: ANN

title: Dengeki Daisy TV Anime Reveals January 2027 Debut, Half-Year Run in Main Promo Video
content: A stage presentation at the KyoMAF event on Saturday revealed the main promotional video for the television anime of Kyousuke Motomi 's Dengeki Daisy shōjo manga. The video reveals the anime will debut in January 2027 and will air for two consecutive cours (quarter of a year).
author: ANN

title: Asteroid Daianji Makes the First Three Volumes of Asteroid in Love Free To Read
content: Manga Time Kirara Carat has announced that Asteroid in Love ‘s first three volumes will be free to read from September 18th to the 23rd to celebrate the discovery of asteroid Daianji. Come On!
author: Anime Corner

title: Bleach Creator Returns With New Look at Aizen Ahead of Anime’s Finale
content: The exciting Fall 2026 anime season is right around the corner, which means fans will have to bid farewell to most of the Summer 2026 shows. This also includes Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War – The Calamity, the fourth part of the anime’s finale arc, which will wrap up the main story from the manga.
author: ComicBook

title: Naruto Is Getting a Live-Action Revival Ahead of Its New Movie
content: Even several years after its ending, Naruto ‘s legacy remains unmatched thanks to its exceptional storytelling and lovable characters. While the manga was already loved before, the anime helped it reach new heights of popularity, creating a global phenomenon.
author: ComicBook

title: Blue Lock Studio Returns for New Dark Fantasy in 2027 – Watch the Trailer
content: Studio 8bit, the animation studio behind Blue Lock , was at the center of controversy in 2024 due to the second season of its biggest sports series. The studio has been around since 2008, and since then it has released dozens of anime shows and movies.
author: ComicBook

title: Boruto Is Finally Preparing to Redeem Naruto’s Most Important Character
content: Boruto: Two Blue Vortex has been developing its narrative perfectly, and now, in the latest chapter following its return from hiatus, the series is providing one of the Naruto franchise’s most important characters with the perfect opportunity to redeem herself.
author: ComicBook
